$comment: Made-up notes for the demo Brain. A path is the chain of titles from one of the roots (a person's name, or Family). updated '@-3' = three days before today. Links are [[Title]] in the text.

notes.body: # Alex
# Sam
# Robin
# Kit
# Family

# Home

Everything about the house. Start with [[Boiler]] and [[Wifi and network]].

# Boiler

Gas combi boiler in the utility cupboard.

- Serviced once a year, usually in October
- Pressure should sit between 1 and 1.5 bar
- Engineer: see [[Trades we use]]

The manual is in the folder above the fuse box.

# Wifi and network

One router in the hall, a mesh point upstairs. The password is in the password manager under "Home wifi", never here.

The wall tablet and the [[Solar panels]] inverter are on the guest network.

# Solar panels

Twelve panels on the south roof, fitted two summers ago. The inverter reports to the Energy page.

Cleaning: once a year, see [[Trades we use]].

# Trades we use

- Boiler: the engineer two streets down, booked by phone
- Roof and gutters: the firm that fitted the [[Solar panels]]
- Electrician: ask next door, they were happy with theirs

# Kitchen refit

Planned for next spring. Budget agreed, see [[Savings goals]].

Decisions so far:
- Keep the layout, replace the worktops
- Induction hob
- [[Alex]] wants a larger sink

# Car

The estate car. MOT is due each March; the garage sends a reminder.

Tyres were changed last winter. Insurance renews in June, see [[Insurance]].

# Money

Pointers only: amounts live on the Finance page.

# Savings goals

1. [[Kitchen refit]]
2. [[Summer in Cornwall]]
3. A cushion of three months of bills

# Insurance

Home, car and travel are all with the same insurer, renewed in June. Documents are in the shared drive under Household.

# Trips

Where we went and where we want to go.

# Summer in Cornwall

A week near St Ives in August. Cottage is reserved, not yet paid in full.

- [[Sam]] books the train
- [[Robin]] wants to surf, see [[Surf lessons]]
- Packing list from [[Lake District 2024]] worked well

# Surf lessons

Two schools on the beach take beginners from age eight. Book a week ahead in August.

# Lake District 2024

Five days in Keswick. Rained for three of them and nobody minded.

Worth repeating: the boat across the lake, the pencil museum for [[Kit]].

# People

Friends, family and neighbours.

# Grandma Jo

Sam's mum. Birthday 14 May. Visits most school holidays and likes the back bedroom.

Loves the garden: see [[Vegetable patch]].

# Next door

Priya and Tom at number 12. They hold a spare key and water the plants when we are away.
# Garden

# Vegetable patch

Three raised beds. This year: tomatoes, beans, courgettes.

[[Kit]] is in charge of watering. [[Grandma Jo]] brought the bean seeds.

# Traditions

- Pancakes on the first day of every school holiday
- Film night on Fridays, [[Robin]] and [[Kit]] take turns to choose
- A walk on New Year's Day whatever the weather
# Work

# Team offsite

Two days in September. Alex is organising the venue.

Clashes with nothing at home; [[Sam]] has the school run that week.

# Reading list

- The book on estimating everyone keeps quoting
- Notes from the spring conference

# Running

Training for a half marathon in October. Three runs a week; long run on Sunday.

The knee is fine as long as the shoes are replaced on time, see [[Knee]].
# Health

# Knee

Physio in the spring for the left knee. Exercises twice a week keep it quiet.

# Ideas

- A proper workbench in the shed
- Learn to bake bread that [[Kit]] will eat
# Work

# Year 5 class

Topics this term: rivers, fractions, the Tudors.

The river trip needs two more parent helpers.

# River trip

Coach is booked. Risk assessment done. Wellies list sent home.

Idea from [[Lake District 2024]]: the boat was the highlight, find one here too.

# Choir

Thursday evenings. Concert in December; [[Grandma Jo]] wants tickets.

# Books

Reading: a long novel about a lighthouse. Next: whatever the book club picks.
# Health

# Hay fever

Starts in May. The usual tablets work; start them two weeks early.

# Football

Saturday league, plays left back. Kit bag lives by the front door.

Boots are a size up since March.
# School

# Science project

A model of the water cycle, due before half term. Needs a clear box and food colouring.

# Wish list

- Surfing in the summer: [[Surf lessons]]
- A telescope

# Drawing

Fills a sketchbook a month. Favourite subject: the cat next door, see [[Next door]].

# Swimming

Lesson on Wednesdays. Just moved up to the deep end group.

# Favourite things

Pencils, pancakes ([[Traditions]]), and the beans in the [[Vegetable patch]].

activity.summary: Wish list linked to the trip
